question: Which of the following is NOT a possible isomer of hexane?
solution:
The correct answer is **'__2 ethyl pentane__'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**Hexane** is an organic compound, a straight-chain alkane **with six carbon atoms **with the **molecular formula C6H14**.

Molecular structure of given atoms as below.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/74cb7089e6757bee0af5f32a008823132b23d579aee0e02af4d1261470b2580c.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/978b05b510f169fa20b0d1a15c9f883cdc9833305c59b7dabf76b42c3db6cb6b.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a3ba1097d7a78ec20c24405c546287e8f78198bc04bed6df83a6f6d5785d03b2.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3032905f8bfb0be3d0bb455289af55c9cce410a6ece0345e12987a03ba59a917.png] 

So, **2-ethyl pentane **has **7 carbon atoms with C₇H₁₆**.

**Hence 2-ethyl pentane is not an isomer of haxane. **
